evidence_items.finding: SEO retainer service representing 40% of total revenue has not had a pricing review in three years despite the market changing
evidence_items.rationale: 40% of revenue on a three-year-old price point with no review is a critical adverse margin signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: one specialist manages 38 of 40 SEO retainer clients — the entirety of a service line generating $840K per year sits with one individual
evidence_items.rationale: Single specialist responsible for 38 of 40 clients in a $840K service line is a critical adverse key-person dependency signal. team_capability; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: no service-line margin data is available — the 52% blended gross margin is calculated across all revenue without breakdown by service type
evidence_items.rationale: Blended margin without service-line breakdown makes it impossible to assess whether the highest-volume service is profitable. process_maturity; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: owner has been considering hiring a second SEO specialist but cannot determine whether the service line margin supports the additional cost
evidence_items.rationale: Inability to assess whether margin supports a hire due to absence of service-line data is an adverse process maturity signal. process_maturity.

evidence_items.finding: digital marketing agency; $2.1M revenue; 52% blended margin; SEO retainer $840K at 3-year price; 1 specialist on 38 clients; no service-line P&L
Surface signal (not root cause): overall gross margin of 52% is healthy for a digital marketing agency and suggests the business is well-managed
evidence_items.rationale: A 52% blended margin is a misleading signal when 40% of revenue has no service-line margin data and is priced at a three-year-old rate — the blended figure may conceal a loss-making service line.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the SEO retainer has been the agency's highest-revenue service for three years and has grown its client count from 20 to 40 in that time
evidence_items.rationale: Growing client count in the SEO retainer is a misleading demand signal — it does not indicate the service is profitable at the current price point, particularly with one specialist managing 38 clients.
